relationships.subject: koumine
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-κB)/nucleotide-binding oligomerization domain, leucine-rich repeat and pyrin domain-containing 3 (NLRP3) signalling pathway proteins and mRNA were reduced in the KM group.

relationships.subject: koumine
relationships.evidence_quote: KM effectively alleviated the symptoms of redness, swelling and pain

key_findings: Koumine alleviated MSU-induced gout symptoms in mice and reduced TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3 pathway expression.
